# Project Phoenix v47.0 — Western-Eurasia Alt-History 2: Twin Eagles of Moscow & Constantinople (1460-1565).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v47_twin_harmony` 0..100).
# Playable BOTH when BYZ survives (Northern Caesar Co-Emperorship) AND when BYZ fell (Third Rome Translation of Empire).
# Human-friendly & AI-restrained via `is_ai = no` or future `global_var:oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed`.
# Generated by gen_v470_alt_varna_rus_andalus.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v47_third_rome_union = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v47_third_rome_union

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1460
		current_year <= 1565
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_third_rome_ended }
		OR = {
			country_exists = c:MOS
			country_exists = c:RUS
			any_country = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				religion ?= religion:orthodox
				num_locations >= 10
				capital ?= { region = region:russian_region }
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = MOS
					tag = RUS
					tag = BYZ
					tag = TRE
					tag = FEO
					tag = NOV
					tag = TUR
					tag = POL
					tag = LIT
					tag = CRI
					tag = WAL
					tag = MOL
					AND = {
						religion ?= religion:orthodox
						capital ?= {
							OR = {
								region = region:russian_region
								region = region:ruthenia_region
								region = region:balkan_region
								region = region:anatolia_region
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			tag = MOS
			tag = RUS
			tag = BYZ
			tag = TRE
			tag = FEO
			tag = NOV
			tag = TUR
			tag = POL
			tag = LIT
			tag = CRI
			religion ?= religion:orthodox
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:russian_region
					region = region:ruthenia_region
					area = area:crimea_area
					area = area:thrace_area
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Living Byzantium — Twin-Eagle Co-Emperorship (Northern Caesar & Basileus)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_twin_end_co_emperorship"
		desc = "oe_v47_twin_end_co_emperorship_desc"
		trigger = {
			country_exists = c:BYZ
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_twin_harmony }
				var:oe_v47_twin_harmony >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_third_rome_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = MOS
						tag = RUS
						tag = BYZ
						tag = TRE
						tag = FEO
						has_variable = oe_v47_twin_axis_member
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_twin_co_emperorship years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Fallen Byzantium — Moscow the Third Rome (Translatio Imperii)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_twin_end_third_rome"
		desc = "oe_v47_twin_end_third_rome_desc"
		trigger = {
			NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_twin_harmony }
				var:oe_v47_twin_harmony >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_third_rome_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = MOS
						tag = RUS
						tag = TRE
						tag = FEO
						has_variable = oe_v47_twin_axis_member
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_legitimacy = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_third_rome_mantle years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Divergent Crowns of North & South (1565 Horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_twin_end_separate_destinies"
		desc = "oe_v47_twin_end_separate_destinies_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1565
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_third_rome_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						has_variable = oe_v47_twin_axis_member
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_orthodox_commonwealth years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_third_rome_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_harmony value = 30 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_byz_lives value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_byz_lives value = 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = MOS
					tag = RUS
					tag = BYZ
					tag = TRE
					tag = FEO
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_axis_member value = 1 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu1_11_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_11_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu1.11
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_twin_harmony } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_harmony value = 30 } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_byz_lives value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_byz_lives value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v47_twin_harmony < 78
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_sophia_embassy
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_double_eagle_seal
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_greco_russian_renaissance
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_harmony add = 0.25 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_twin_harmony > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_harmony value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_twin_harmony < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_twin_harmony value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_third_rome_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_third_rome_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = MOS
						tag = RUS
						tag = BYZ
						tag = TRE
						tag = FEO
						has_variable = oe_v47_twin_axis_member
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_twin_map_axis_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { religion ?= religion:orthodox }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_twin_map_orthodox_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = TUR
						tag = CRI
						tag = GLH
						tag = KAZ
						tag = POL
						tag = LIT
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_twin_map_rivals_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = MOS
						tag = RUS
						tag = BYZ
						tag = TRE
						tag = FEO
						has_variable = oe_v47_twin_axis_member
					}
				}
			}
			value = purple_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { religion ?= religion:orthodox }
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = TUR
						tag = CRI
						tag = GLH
						tag = KAZ
						tag = POL
						tag = LIT
					}
				}
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_twin_legend_axis"
		color = rgb { 172 86 184 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_twin_legend_orthodox"
		color = rgb { 62 152 146 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_twin_legend_rivals"
		color = rgb { 184 82 58 }
	}
}
